tickets.title: Prepare home-care funding projection for Cloudpuddles
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side projection for Lena and Arun Cloudpuddle comparing continued weekday home-care aides, expanded evening coverage, and a limited assisted-living trial. Use current Pocket Lantern Home Care invoices (~$3,400/month), Lena's 60% short-term disability from her prior $148,000 salary, Arun's $3,850 monthly pension and $2,420 monthly Social Security, the $780,000 joint taxable account and Lena's $510,000 IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody, and Arun's $430,000 401(k) at Silver Marmot Transit.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to prepare that projection for 2024-06-07.

tickets.title: Coordinate long-term care claim packet with Buttonwood Balloon Life

tickets.title: Resolve long-term care daily benefit mismatch with Buttonwood Balloon Life
tickets.text: Resolve the daily benefit mismatch on Lena Cloudpuddle's Buttonwood Balloon Life long-term care policy. The insurer portal lists a $180 daily benefit while the policy declaration page in the household planning file states a $210 daily benefit; the correct figure is needed before claim assumptions can be modeled.

tickets.title: Develop backup caregiver coverage schedule and cost range
tickets.text: Develop a temporary caregiver coverage schedule and estimated short-term cost range for Lena and Arun Cloudpuddle before Arun's knee rehabilitation begins. Arun's recovery will reduce his ability to drive Lena and cover transfers at home, so the plan should cover weekday transportation, transfers, and respite during his recovery period.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to develop that schedule and cost range for 2024-06-12.
